title: Netflix Faces New Backlash After Steel Ball Run JoJo Fans Call for Ending Theme Change Due to Dr. Luke Credit
content: Netflix is facing new backlash following the release of the ending theme for STEEL BALL RUN JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure at the start of the anime’s 2nd and 3rd STAGE, with some fans calling for the song to be replaced after learning that Dr. Luke is credited as its producer.
author: Anime Corner

title: TenSura Season 4 Cour 3 Set for July 2027, Clayman REVENGE Anime Announced for April
content: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ( TenSura ) Season 4 will continue with its third cour in July 2027. In addition, the official spin-off That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime: Clayman REVENGE is getting a TV anime adaptation, set to begin in April 2027.
author: Anime Corner

title: Chizu Kamikō's Seijo Mellia to Sennen Ōkoku no Kishi Manga Ends
content: Chizu Kamikō 's Seijo Mellia to Sennen Ōkoku no Kishi ( Saint Melia and Knight of the Millennial Kingdom ) manga ended on the KadoComi website on Friday. The story follows Melia, a young girl unable to use magic who suffers at the hands of her new caretakers after being separated from her beloved grandmother.
author: ANN

title: Frieren Celebrates 3rd Anime Anniversary With Special Visual, Season 3 Still One Year Away
content: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End has revealed a special new visual to mark the third anniversary of the anime’s first broadcast in September 2023. The announcement was made during a special Season 2 screening event , attended by the main voice cast.
author: Anime Corner

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Sixteenth and Final Ending Featuring "Canvas" by +Plus
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its sixteenth and final ending, featuring the song “Canvas” by +Plus. The song was used in Episodes 191-203, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Fifteenth Ending Featuring "Famiglia" by D-51
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its fifteenth ending, featuring the song “Famiglia” by D-51. The song was used in Episodes 178-190, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner

title: Code Geass New Anime Announced for 2027 With Teaser Trailer, Visual, and Staff
content: A new Code Geass anime titled CODE GEASS Star Chaser Aspal has been announced for 2027, revealing its teaser trailer, visual, as well as the main staff. title: Future GPX Cyber Formula's New Anime Short Reveals Cast, Staff, Screening on February 19
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks announced on Saturday that its planned new anime short for the Future GPX Cyber Formula series will screen alongside a new HD remastered "movie edition" of the Future GPX Cyber Formula: Early Days Renewal compilation OVA in Japan starting on February 19, 2027.
author: ANN

title: The Fake Alchemist Reveals First PV and Key Production Details
content: The production committee for The Fake Alchemist ( Nisemono no Renkinjutsushi )has released a promotional video and announced the anime’s cast and staff. Miyari Nemoto and Youhei Matsuoka will voice the leads, Nora and Paracelsus, respectively.
author: Anime Corner

title: Every Anime Coming to Netflix in October 2026
content: The Fall 2026 anime season is almost here, and all major platforms are planning to release new shows for fans across the globe. Crunchyroll by far has the largest lineup, just like every other season. The platform always releases almost all of the new seasonal shows, and this time is no different.
author: ComicBook
